oneOf.description: Authoritative completion arrived, but is not yet necessarily retained.
Discard the transient preview; this does not claim success or cancellation.

description:
Transient Web search visibility alongside the ordered item stream.

Scope previews by thread, turn, attempt and output index. Item IDs bind a preview to the corresponding ordered Web item in that attempt. A newer attempt supersedes older previews. Ignore older attempts and clear previews on terminal turns, thread replacement and cold replay. Only item/completed creates history or supplies results; completed activity merely stops busy UI.

attemptId.description: Increasing, JavaScript-safe integer generated by this server process.
